text: {"lessons":["Five months of price changes are not a reliable forecast; I should not chase recent gains or sell solely because prices fell.","I should judge each holding by its future prospects, not my average cost or the discomfort of admitting a mistake; taking a gain should not be an end in itself.","Because I check infrequently, I should use a deliberate review and diversification plan rather than let loss aversion or short-term account swings drive decisions."]}
